summary: TRIP is a self-hosted tool designed for tracking points of interest on maps and organising itineraries. It functions as a centralised planner for geographic locations and travel routes. The application is distributed under the MIT licence and provides containerised deployment.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to commercial map trackers and itinerary planners.
watchOut: With a modest community and standard maintenance metrics, you may encounter edge cases or lack support compared to mainstream travel platforms.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based service, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your map data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
